name: vSphere Manager Node
description: Hyper-V VM - 2 vCPU MKE/Docker manager node (svpx-dockmgr*). Runs on Intel Xeon Gold 6254 host in League City, TX datacenter. Hosts MKE control plane, not application workloads.

specifications.cpu_model: Intel Xeon Gold 6254 @ 3.10GHz (Cascade Lake, 18-core, 200W TDP) — confirmed via lscpu on svpx-dockmgr01
specifications.notes: VM has 2 vCPUs out of 18 physical cores. Effective VM TDP share = 200W × (2/18) ≈ 22.2W. Hypervisor reports as Microsoft (Hyper-V) on svpx-dockmgr01. Memory estimated at 8GB — confirm via vCenter if needed.

embodied_carbon.vm_share_notes: Embodied carbon allocated proportionally: physical CPU × (2 vCPU / 18 physical cores).

cpu.source: Boavizta estimate for Intel Xeon Gold 6254 (Cascade Lake 14nm, ~80,000 gCO2e total) × 2/18 vCPU share

infrastructure_share.source: Proportional share of motherboard, chassis, PSU, NIC, cooling (2/18 of host)

embodied_carbon.allocation_method: Proportional vCPU share of physical host (2/18 cores)

lifespan.notes: Aligned with physical host refresh cycle

pue.source: Uptime Institute 2021 average for enterprise data centers
pue.notes: Replace with actual League City datacenter PUE if known
